description: Run {python_runtime} code. {python_sdk_documentation} CSV tables use the same worksheet/style objects as openpyxl: await locus.csv.load_workbook(path), edit wb.active with normal openpyxl code, then await wb.save(). See csv.md for the supported display subset; CSV has no Excel protection or calculation engine.

code.description: Python code to execute. Top-level await is supported.

readonly.description: Whether the code and all nested calls only observe state.

timeout.description: Execution timeout in milliseconds. Default 120000; maximum 1800000.
